## Modules

- [ExAST](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.md): Search, replace, and diff Elixir code by AST pattern.
- [ExAST.Comment](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Comment.md): A source comment with line/column metadata.
- [ExAST.Comments](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Comments.md): Extracts comments from Elixir source while preserving source positions.

- [ExAST.CompiledPattern](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.CompiledPattern.md): Precomputed metadata for an ExAST pattern.

- [ExAST.Diff](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Diff.md): Syntax-aware diffing for Elixir source code.
- [ExAST.Diff.Edit](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Diff.Edit.md): A single syntax-aware edit between two Elixir sources.

- [ExAST.Diff.Patcher](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Diff.Patcher.md): Applies diff edits to produce patched source code.
- [ExAST.Diff.Result](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Diff.Result.md): The result of comparing two Elixir sources.

- [ExAST.Index](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Index.md): Candidate-index metadata for ExAST patterns and selectors.
- [ExAST.Index.Plan](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Index.Plan.md): Indexable summary of an ExAST pattern or selector.
- [ExAST.Index.Terms](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Index.Terms.md): Conservative structural terms extracted from Elixir AST and ExAST patterns.
- [ExAST.PatchConflict](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.PatchConflict.md): Describes overlapping replacement ranges in a rewrite plan.

- [ExAST.Patcher](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Patcher.md): Finds and replaces AST patterns in source code.
- [ExAST.Pattern](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Pattern.md): AST pattern matching with captures.
- [ExAST.Query](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Query.md): SQL-like query API for AST search.
- [ExAST.Rewriter](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Rewriter.md): Builds and applies replacement plans without immediately changing files.

- [ExAST.Rewriter.Plan](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Rewriter.Plan.md): A rewrite plan that can be inspected, encoded, or applied.

- [ExAST.Rewriter.Replacement](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Rewriter.Replacement.md): A planned source replacement.

- [ExAST.Selector](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Selector.md): CSS-like AST selector builder.
- [ExAST.Selector.CommentMatcher](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Selector.CommentMatcher.md): Comment text matcher used by comment predicates.

- [ExAST.Selector.Predicate](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Selector.Predicate.md): Predicate used by `ExAST.Selector.where/2`.
- [ExAST.Sigil](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Sigil.md): Provides the `~p` sigil for compile-time pattern parsing.
- [ExAST.Symbol.Definition](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Symbol.Definition.md): A module, function, macro, callback, or attribute definition found in Elixir code.
- [ExAST.Symbol.Reference](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Symbol.Reference.md): A local or remote reference found in Elixir code.
- [ExAST.Symbols](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/ExAST.Symbols.md): Extracts lightweight definition and reference facts from Elixir source or AST.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix ex_ast.diff](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.ExAst.Diff.md): Computes a syntax-aware diff between two Elixir files.
- [mix ex_ast.replace](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.ExAst.Replace.md): Replaces AST pattern matches in Elixir source files.
- [mix ex_ast.search](https://ex-ast.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.ExAst.Search.md): Searches for AST patterns in Elixir source files.
